subject: Re: Demo request — Redwood benchmark report
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mason Riley <mason.riley@dataops.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request — Redwood benchmark report

Hi Mason,

Thanks for downloading our benchmark report last week — appreciate the interest. I pulled your details from the download form at DataOps Inc and wanted to see if you'd be open to a short demo focused on the cost and latency numbers you were looking at. A 30-minute slot is usually enough to walk through the benchmark methodology and show how those numbers map to real inferencing savings.

Would any of these work for you next week?
- Tue 5/25 11:00–11:30 PDT
- Wed 5/26 14:00–14:30 PDT
- Thu 5/27 16:00–16:30 PDT

If none of those fit, feel free to grab a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/demo-30

I attached the report you downloaded plus a one-page demo agenda so you have context. If you have specific latency/throughput questions (e.g., 1k qps, 8k token context), mention them and I’ll loop in Connor, our SE, to cover the deeper perf details.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
SDR, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference
Attachments: benchmark-report-Redwood-vs-OpenComparison.pdf, demo-agenda-DataOps.pdf

From: Mason Riley <mason.riley@dataops.ai>

Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@dataops.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — Redwood benchmark report

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for reaching out — I did download the report, and this looks promising. Elaine (cc'd) is our ML infra lead and should join the call. We have a tight window late next week; Thu 5/27 at 16:00 PDT would be the best for us, but if possible we'd prefer 16:30 — do you have any flexibility?

Quick context so the demo is focused: we evaluate options to reduce per-token cost on our inference fleet (models are a mixture of open-weights and LLM distillations). The benchmark numbers are helpful but we need to better understand production latency under a sustained 500 qps workload and eviction behavior for long contexts.

Also: do you share any standard SOC2 evidence or a security questionnaire prior to the demo? Our procurement team will request that later in the process.

Best,
Mason Riley
Senior Platform Engineer, DataOps Inc
mason.riley@dataops.ai
(External)

Hi Mason / Elaine —

Thanks for the quick reply. 16:30 on Thu 5/27 works for us; I just sent a calendar invite for Thu, May 27 · 4:30 – 5:00pm PDT and included Connor (SE) and Marissa (AE) on the invite so we can cover both the benchmark methodology and the procurement/price discussion. Please accept if the time is confirmed. Invite includes a short agenda and the Drive folder with the report and some perf slides.

Connor — quick FYI: DataOps is evaluating cost/latency at ~500 qps sustained and will want to discuss KV cache eviction and quantization profiles.

Marissa — I’ll loop you in on procurement next if they request contract/discount guidance; Mason flagged that procurement will ask for SOC2 evidence later.

Agenda (attached in invite):
- 5 min: intros & current infra
- 15 min: benchmark methodology + perf slides
- 7 min: mapping to DataOps workload (qps/latency)
- 3 min: next steps (procurement / follow-up evals)

Thanks —
